articles.author: Maris Tech Ltd.
articles.headline: Maris-Tech Receives Record US$10 Million Order - Its Largest-Ever Contract - for Advanced Video Systems on Next-Generation Airborne Defense Platforms
articles.summary: Maris-Tech announces a $10 million advanced airborne-video order in collaboration with Magam Safety, with most delivery expected by the end of 2028. Potential follow-ons up to approximately $14.1 million total are conditional possibilities, distinct from the initial order and from recognized revenue.
